title: Pressing Escape while resizing an applet should cancel & revert it
line: Pressing Escape while resizing a desktop widget now cancels the resize and puts the widget back to its old size.
explanation: The desktop's resize handles (ResizeHandle in containmentlayoutmanager) only reacted to the mouse, so Escape pressed mid-drag went on to the rest of Plasma: it quit edit mode (and Show Desktop, as in the report) while the widget kept whatever size it had reached. Nothing remembered the starting size to go back to. While a handle is pressed it now filters the window's key presses; Escape restores the geometry saved at press time, places the widget back in the layout and releases the mouse grab, so moving or releasing the mouse no longer resizes.

commits.message:
containmentlayoutmanager: cancel widget resize with Escape

Pressing Escape while dragging a desktop widget's resize handle left the
widget at its new size and quit edit mode. The handle now catches Escape
while pressed, puts back the size it had before the drag and ends it.

BUG: 451682

media.caption: Master: left, dragging the bottom-right handle in edit mode; right, after Escape: edit mode is gone and the widget kept the new size.
Fixed: left, same drag; right, after Escape: the widget is back to its old size and edit mode stays open.
